Identify the correct statements from the following:

(a) In Orthoboric acid, boron is in planar geometry. 

(b) In BCl3·NH3, boron has tetrahedral geometry. 

(c) Aqueous solution of borax is acidic.
questions.solution:
1. In orthoboric acid H3BO3, boron is sp2 hybridized and thus is in planar geometry.

2. In BCl3.NH3, Boron and Nitrogen (N)are both sp3 hybridized and the shape of the adduct is tetrahedral .

3. Combination of a strong base and a weak acid results in a salt which is basic in nature. Borax is a salt which is formed by the reaction of NaOH (strong base) with H3BO3 (weak acid). Thus, the aqueous solution of borax is basic and not acidic.

Van der Waals equation is the modified form of ideal gas equation which gives the relationship between the pressure, volume, temperature and number of moles of real gases.

For 'n' moles of a real gas, it can be written as,

P+an2V2V-nb=nRT

questions.q: If two tangents to the parabola <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><mn>8</mn><mi>x</mi></math> meet the tangent at its vertex in <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>M</mi></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>N</mi></math> such that <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>M</mi><mi>N</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn></math>, then the locus of the point of intersection of those two tangents is
questions.solution:
Given parabola is y2=8x.

Comparing with y2=4ax, we get

4a=8 ⇒a=2

Let the parametric co-ordinates of P & Q be at12, 2at1 & at22, 2at2 respectively.

So, equation of tangent at P is yt1=x+2t12 ...........i

and the equation of tangent at Q is yt2=x+2t22 ...........ii

Since, its given that tangent at the vertex meet at points M & N.

So, to find M, we put x=0 in equation i, we get

yt1=0+2t12⇒y=2t1

and to find N, we put x=0 in equation ii, we get

yt2=0+2t22⇒y=2t2

So, the co-ordinates of M & N are 0, 2t1 & 0, 2t2 respectively.

It is also given that MN=4.

⇒2t1-2t2=4

⇒t1-t2=2

⇒t1-t22=4 ..........iii

We also know that the point of intersection of two tangent to a parabola whose parametric co-ordinates are at12, 2at1 & at22, 2at2 meet at R whose co-ordinates is at1t2, at1+t2=2t1t2, 2t1+t2=h, k.

Now, t1+t22=t1-t22+4t1t2

⇒k22=4+4h2 (using equation iii)

⇒k24=4+2h

⇒k2=8h+2

For locus of R, replacing h→x & k→y, we get

y2=8x+2

Hence, the required locus equation is y2=8x+2.

Let the required vector is ai^+bj^+ck^.

As the three vectors ai^+bj^+ck^, i^+j^ & j^+k^ are coplanar so one must be linear combination of other two i.e,
ai^+bj^+ck^=λi^+j^+μj^+k^

On comparison, we get

a=λ, c=μ & b=λ+μ⇒b=a+c

Only option bi^-j^-2k^ has a=1, b=-1, c=-2 such that a+c=1-2=-1=b⇒b=a+c

So, the required vector is i^-j^-2k^.

questions.q:
Assertion (A): When we bounce a ball on the ground, it comes to rest after a few bounces, losing all its energy. This is an example of violation of conservation of energy.

Reason (R): Energy can change from one form to another but the total energy is always conserved.

Which of the following is true?
options: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
questions.solution: The moment ball coming to rest mean that the initial potential energy of the ball gets converted to kinetic energy and when this energy is being used to counteract the energy loss during its motion.
